nodes.title: Decomposition of finite multiple zeta values into level-$N$ pieces

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $p$ and $N$, the colored finite multiple harmonic sum $\zeta^{\varnothing}_{p,N}(\varnothing)$ of the empty index, with the empty tuple of colors, equals $1$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Colored finite multiple harmonic sum of the empty index

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $N$ be natural numbers, let $k = (k_1, \dots, k_r)$ be a finite sequence of natural numbers and let $\alpha = (\alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_r) \in (\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})^r$. The colored finite multiple harmonic sum $\zeta^{\alpha}_{p,N}(k) \in \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ is the sum of $m_1^{-k_1} \cdots m_r^{-k_r}$ over all integers $0 < m_1 < \dots < m_r < p$ with $m_i \equiv \alpha_i \pmod N$ for every $i$.
nodes.title: Colored finite multiple harmonic sums

nodes.summary: The following are equivalent: (a) there is a natural number $M$ such that for every prime $p \ge 5$ there is an odd integer $k$ with $3 \le k \le M$, $k < p$ and $p \nmid \operatorname{num}(B_{p-k})$; (b) there is a natural number $M \ge 5$ such that only finitely many primes $p$ satisfy $k < p$ and $p \mid \operatorname{num}(B_{p-k})$ for every odd integer $k$ with $3 \le k \le M$.
nodes.title: Criterion for a uniform bound on the least non-vanishing Bernoulli index

nodes.summary: The following are equivalent: (a) there is a natural number $M$ such that for every odd prime $p$ there is an integer $N$ with $1 \le N \le M$, $p \nmid N$ and $p^2 \nmid N^{p-1} - 1$; (b) there is a natural number $M \ge 3$ such that only finitely many primes $p$ satisfy $p^2 \mid N^{p-1} - 1$ for every integer $N$ with $2 \le N \le M$.
nodes.title: Criterion for a uniform bound on the least non-Wieferich base

nodes.summary: (i) Suppose that infinitely many odd primes $p$ are regular, in the sense that $p$ does not divide the class number of any $p$-th cyclotomic field over $\mathbb{Q}$. nodes.title: Regular and non-Wieferich primes give non-vanishing finite multiple zeta values

nodes.title: Raising the level of finite multiple zeta values

nodes.summary: For every prime $p \ge 11$ there is an odd integer $k \ge 3$ such that $p$ does not divide the numerator of the Bernoulli number $B_{p-k}$ and $k \le (p-3)/2$ if $p \equiv 1 \pmod 4$, while $k \le (p-5)/2$ if $p \equiv 3 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: A small odd $k$ with $p \nmid B_{p-k}$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime that is not a Wieferich prime, that is, $p^2 \nmid 2^{p-1} - 1$. Then there are no integers $x, y, z$ with $p \nmid xyz$ and $x^p + y^p = z^p$.
nodes.title: Wieferich's criterion for the first case of Fermat's Last Theorem

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $K$ be a $p$-th cyclotomic field over $\mathbb{Q}$ (a number field generated over $\mathbb{Q}$ by a primitive $p$-th root of unity). If $p$ does not divide the class number of $K$, then Fermat's Last Theorem holds for the exponent $p$: there are no positive integers $a, b, c$ with $a^p + b^p = c^p$.
nodes.title: Kummer's theorem for regular primes

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and $N$ a positive integer with $p \nmid N$. Write $q_p(2) = (2^{p-1} - 1)/p$ for the Fermat quotient of $2$, and for integers $i \ge 0$ and $M \ge 1$ let $s_p(i, M) \in \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ be the sum of $m^{-1}$ over the integers $m$ with $0 < m < p$ and $ip/M < m < (i+1)p/M$. Then $(N + 1)\, q_p(2) \equiv -\sum_{0 \le j < N/2} s_p(2j, 2N) \pmod{p}$.
nodes.title: Skula–Dobson–Ichimura congruence for the Fermat quotient of $2$

nodes.title: The empty color map gives zero

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $p$ and $N$, every tuple $k = (k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of natural numbers and every $\alpha \in (\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})^r$, if $c$ is the color map sending every $a \in \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ to $\alpha$, then the $p$-component $\zeta^c_{\mathcal{A},N}(k)_p$ of the finite multiple zeta value of level $N$ with color map $c$ equals the colored finite multiple harmonic sum $\zeta^{\alpha}_{p,N}(k)$.
